winex11: 线程数据 NULL 检查
patches.patch:
From edaebb866b9276b4d323844548bc18e790aab406 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: BrunoSX <brunodeveloper85@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:45:22 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] winex11: Add a NULL check for the thread data

---
 dlls/winex11.drv/window.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/dlls/winex11.drv/window.c b/dlls/winex11.drv/window.c
index d9c19ab7..9584349e 100755
--- a/dlls/winex11.drv/window.c
+++ b/dlls/winex11.drv/window.c
@@ -1157,8 +1157,9 @@ static void update_net_wm_fullscreen_monitors( struct x11drv_win_data *data )
 static void window_set_net_wm_state( struct x11drv_win_data *data, UINT new_state )
 {
     UINT i, count, old_state = data->pending_state.net_wm_state;
+    struct x11drv_thread_data *thread_data = x11drv_thread_data();
 
-    new_state &= x11drv_thread_data()->net_wm_state_mask;
+    if (thread_data) new_state &= thread_data->net_wm_state_mask;
     data->desired_state.net_wm_state = new_state;
     if (!data->whole_window || !data->managed || data->embedded) return; /* no window or not managed, nothing to update */
     if (data->wm_state_serial) return; /* another WM_STATE update is pending, wait for it to complete */

From f7c7cecd79f4da546648a7fc0224e8d3bb657f24 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: BrunoSX <brunodeveloper85@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 17:17:01 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] mf: Add a NULL check for the audio client

---
 dlls/mf/sar.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/dlls/mf/sar.c b/dlls/mf/sar.c
index 19e4eeda..206960ff 100755
--- a/dlls/mf/sar.c
+++ b/dlls/mf/sar.c
@@ -1458,7 +1458,7 @@ static HRESULT WINAPI audio_renderer_stream_Flush(IMFStreamSink *iface)
         }
     }
     renderer->queued_frames = 0;
-    if (FAILED(hr = IAudioClient_Reset(renderer->audio_client)))
+    if (renderer->audio_client && FAILED(hr = IAudioClient_Reset(renderer->audio_client)))
         WARN("Failed to reset audio client, hr %#lx.\n", hr);
     LeaveCriticalSection(&renderer->cs);

winemenubuilder: 等待父进程加超时
patches.patch:
From 82efd39c5c94d894fcf2d25dcc26f0611902f76b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: BrunoSX <brunodeveloper85@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 11:48:09 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] winemenubuilder: Add timeout to wait for parent process

---
 programs/winemenubuilder/winemenubuilder.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/programs/winemenubuilder/winemenubuilder.c b/programs/winemenubuilder/winemenubuilder.c
index f3ed125c..259e8269 100755
--- a/programs/winemenubuilder/winemenubuilder.c
+++ b/programs/winemenubuilder/winemenubuilder.c
@@ -2491,7 +2491,7 @@ static BOOL WaitForParentProcess( void )
         goto done;
     }
 
-    if (MsgWaitForMultipleObjects( 1, &hprocess, FALSE, INFINITE, QS_ALLINPUT ) == WAIT_OBJECT_0)
+    if (MsgWaitForMultipleObjects( 1, &hprocess, FALSE, 1000, QS_ALLINPUT ) == WAIT_OBJECT_0)
         ret = TRUE;
     else
         WINE_ERR("Unable to wait for parent process, error %ld\n", GetLastError());
